text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, Cheval-chan.
For getting injured like this."

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
"‘I couldn't... keep our promise...
I'm so, so sorry...’"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
No way...! You don't have to apologize.
This isn't something for you to apologize for, Shine...!

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
"Cheval-chan...
Even so... I...!"

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
""Ngh, what should I do...
What should I do, Cheval-chan...!?""

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: "I'm scared...!"

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
"‘I know I have to get the surgery.
Because if I don't,
I'll never be able to run again...!’"

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
"B-But, ugh... but...
The chances of success are ridiculously low, aren't they—"

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
"Forget running...
I might not... even be able to walk...?!"

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
"Even so... if I want to run,
if I want to make my dream come true, I have no choice but to try...
I know that, and yet...!"

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: ‘I'm scared...!’

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Shine...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Hearing such terrible news about her childhood friend,
Cheval Grand's heart must be aching terribly."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I know full well how close the two of them are.
The shock must be immeasurable.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Perhaps we should cancel our entry in the 'Japan Cup' and take a break from training until she settles down—"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Training... again today.
Please take care of me."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...How is it, I wonder.
I don't really know."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
“Still.
The strongest feeling I have right now is—”

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I want to 'win'.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I want to win. ...I want to prove I can win.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
I...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Please, win the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I will become a "great Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
To the precious, irreplaceable one in my life.
...I'll become an Umamusume who can pass on courage to her...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing Cheval Grand declare that with such conviction—
She really, truly had grown so strong.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "And one more thing," they continued.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
There is... one more thing.
...A favor I'd like to ask of you.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: There was a special program where the Japan Cup runners were invited, right...?
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah, come to think of it...
Y-Yeah, come to think of it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had received an appearance offer the other day.
However, Cheval Grand was still not very fond of being in the spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even when I first told her the offer had arrived,
I recall her not seeming
all that keen on it, but...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Is it still... not too late to give my answer?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I want to run in it.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Shine.
I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: "Ngh, huh...?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe right now...
you don't want to see or hear anything
about racing, but..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Even so.
...I want you, to watch.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
There's a special program featuring the runners
leading up to the Japan Cup.
It's being streamed online, too.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm... going to enter it.
Shine, I want you to watch.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...There's something I want to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: "Cheval-chan..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "No—it's not just about telling you. ...I'll make a vow."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
In front of everyone.
I'll swear it to the whole world.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I want you to watch me, Shine.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
“—Please welcome them to the stage!
Here are the Umamusume who have declared
their entry into this autumn's 'Japan Cup'!”

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Nǐ hǎo!
I'm Satono Crown. Nice to meet you!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm Kitasan Black!!
Please let me chat with you lots today!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Esultazione! Thank you for the invitation.
I promise to compose a heart-stirring prelude for you.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: …………Ah, I-I'll also――

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Um.
I look forward... to working with you...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Cheval Grand strongly requested it herself,
which led to her appearance on the 'Japan Cup' special program."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A dislike of being in the spotlight and a fear of standing before a crowd aren't things that simply vanish overnight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On top of that, all of my co-stars are either so good at showing off their charms, or just overflowing with glamorous appeal—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Throughout the show, Cheval Grand struggled
to stand out.
...Understandably so, of course.
choice_data_list: (...Still, I know you can do it—!)
(...Still, I know you can do it—!)

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Now, as much as we hate to part, our program
is finally nearing its end.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Well then, could we have a few words from each of our performers to close things out?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... Excuse me!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, at that very moment...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a voice slightly too loud,
cracking halfway through, yet still—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Cheval Grand was the very first to speak up.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Kh, um.
May I... speak, please?

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Huh, ah... Y-Yes, absolutely!
Please, Cheval Grand-san!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
In the end, in a place like this... I can't stand out at all.
I'm just too much of a coward to even try.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Meek. Envious. Insignificant.
I just... hate myself."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't be like my glamorous family at all.
Nor could I be like my cool peers at all.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I do think I've gotten stronger.
I know I've made it this far, but—"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: In the end, I'm still just me.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Just as I am, unlike anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Still—it's fine just like this.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. ...It really is.
Because, even someone like me—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, because I'm like that!
I was taught that I could give courage to someone else!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Just as I am!
Even someone like me, just as I am, still...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Against all these amazing runners—against Kitasan Black,
Satono Crown, and Sounds of Earth—
I will win the Japan Cup!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Win, and become—a "great Umamusume"!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I will become a "great Umamusume" who can pass courage on to others!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I... will become one.
Please, watch me.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...It's a promise.
Make sure you watch me...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, I-I'm sorry.
Um, that's all from me—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (O-... Oooooohhhhhhhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After falling dead silent for a split second, the venue was instantly engulfed in an earth-shattering roar of cheers!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
S-Sensational! What a passionate declaration of victory!
Everyone in the venue is practically bursting with excitement!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, seriously!
You really came through at the very end, Cheval!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Cheval-chan...!!
I'm starting to get super fired up too, whoooo!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, truly energico!!
We've been swept up
by such a spirited declaration."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
After hearing a solo like that—
we have no choice but to play our response.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Cheval-chan!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ngh...! K-Kita-san.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for letting all those feelings out.
In that case, we're gonna give it
everything we've got in return!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Let's clash at the Japan Cup!
Toward my dream, everyone's dream, and your dream, Cheval-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Let's run with everything we've got together.
Let's have a match, Cheval-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Yeah...!!
